{{Quotation|game|One of the oldest standing structures on the Istani Isles, the Sunspear Great Hall dates back to the time of [[Sogolon the Protector]], who turned the Sunspears into an independent order devoted to the protection of all [[Elona]]. The twin, magical fountains are a tribute to the Sunspears' primeval roots, while the Great Hall stands as a memorial to the many generations of heroes forged within its walls.}}

The [[Sunspear Great Hall]] is the headquarters of the [[Order of the Sunspears]].

==Getting there==
The Sunspear Great Hall sits in the center of the [[Plains of Jarin]], to the northwest of [[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan]].

Several quests that are offered in Kamadan (but only for [[Nightfall]] characters) will lead characters to this location, such as [[Armored Transport]] and [[Quality Steel]]. For characters of other [[campaign]]s, the [[Battle Preparations]] quest (the follow-up quest to [[Sunspears in Kryta]] and [[Sunspears in Cantha]]) will lead characters to this location.
